Option B — night bold: immersive dark, electric cyan + amber money accents, Sora/Manrope/JetBrains Mono, pill controls, oversized numerals. Tradeoff vs Option A: more presence and glanceability at the charger, but heavier visual voice and lower daylight readability.
Same flow and amounts as Option A for direct comparison: ₱48.50/kWh, 18.4 kWh → ₱892.40 captured, ₱607.60 released.
